basic_info.description: Welcome to 122 Ney St, offering 1,654 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space across a two-level suite on a 2,750 sq. ft. lot. This exceptional residence features 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, providing ample space and comfort.    The main level boasts a spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxation. Adjacent to the living room is an elegant formal dining area, ideal for both intimate gatherings and festive celebrations.    Upstairs, you'll find beautiful hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and two generously sized bedrooms alongside a well-appointed bathroom. The lower levelbuilt with permitsoffers additional versatility with a comfortable living room, a wet bar area, two bedrooms, and a full bathroom, perfect for guests, extended family, or potential rental opportunities.    The expansive backyard is ideal for family gatherings and outdoor entertainment, offering a private and peaceful retreat. Conveniently located, the property provides easy access to major freeways and public transportation, while the nearby Manila Supermarket enhances everyday convenience with cultural richness.    Please note that room counts may differ from tax records; buyers are encouraged to verify all information.
